title: Ding Talaingat ning Lihim a Pamamupul
intro: keng metung a gabun a berde, metung a grupu da reng indibidwal ing ginawang lihim a planu lalam ning takpan ning karalumduman. Atin lang metung a sangkan, pero ing karelang intensyun marayu ya keng katuliran. E ra balu na ing metung a dibinung pamagbayu manaya karela kabang matudtud la.
clues: Atin kaming matatag a desisyun, isipan mi na alang kapintasan ing kekaming planu.
Balak mi ing lumual kaming maaga, bayu la pa man makagising deng aliwa.
Mibili kami keng metung a mataba a gabun, tiwala keng kekaming probisyon.
Inyang miras kami king pupuntalan mi, disnan mi yang alang tanaman at alang tau, inya inisip mi king melili kami king dalan.
Kanita mi abalu na ita ing kekaming lugal, at menangis kami keng pangawala ning kapanayan, sisisi mi ing metung at metung keng kekaming pangawala.
Sinumpa kami kanitang abak a ita na ilako mi la reng pakakalulu keng kekaming pupul, pero ing parusa ning Allah dinatang ya kekami kabang matudtud kami, gewa neng kasiran ing kekaming mula.

identity.label: Ninu Tamu?
options: Ding makibandi keng mula keng surah 68
Ding Tau ning Saba

Ding Tau ning Elepante
Ding Tau ning Kanal
identity.answer: Ding makibandi keng mula keng surah 68

Ing kekaming garden melaso ya keng albug

Ing kekaming hardin mitmu ya kareng balang

trial.answer: Ing kekaming hardin mesira ya keng sakuna ibat banua

location.label: Key Element
options: sinumpa kami na mamulut kami kareng bunga na keng abak
Megpagawa kaming dam para patubigan ing mula mi
Migsalikut kami keng metung a kueba para keng proteksyun
Migsadia kaming sundalus ban sakupan ing metung a kayarian

location.answer: sinumpa kami na mamulut kami kareng bunga na keng abak

outcome.label: Ating Tadhana
options: migsisi kami at menaya kami keng lunus ibat kang Allah
Lubus kaming mesira at e mi sinisi kapilan man
Tinakas kami king gabun at e na kami migbalik pasibayu
Meging mayupaya at mabandi tamu pasibayu
Meparusan kami king pamaging unggoy
outcome.answer: migsisi kami at menaya kami keng lunus ibat kang Allah

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
